thread:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — we've got an incident impacting onboarding invites after the 02:09 deploy. New users see failures or long hangs, some SSO handoffs timed out. I drafted a customer note below; need credit guidance and owners for outreach.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: ONBOARD-INVITE-504 at 2026-03-20T02:10:14Z — assigned to #eng-oncall.
Marco Rivera: I'm querying which orgs saw retries/failures, will post a short list in 15m.
Samir Gupta: Quick summary from infra: a config change to token-cache TTL caused a spike in auth DB connections. We rolled back the deploy at 02:14 and the cache TTL reverted; error rate dropped but there is a backlog for invite callbacks. Estimated time to clear queued callbacks: ~90–150 minutes.
Priya Patel: Thanks Samir. Which cohorts are impacted (trial/onboarding vs active customers)? renewal risk?
Samir Gupta: Mostly new signups and trial-onboarding flows. A small number of live accounts also hit the failing invite path when re-inviting users. Not seeing core inference requests affected.
Jade (CS Ops): Proposed external comm (short):

"Hi — we experienced an issue with onboarding invites between 02:09–02:14 UTC that could have delayed or blocked new user signups. The root cause was a config change that impacted token validation. The deploy was rolled back, and the backlog is clearing. We apologize for the disruption. If your team saw failed invites or onboarding delays, reply here and we will prioritize manual remediation and issue a goodwill credit. A full RCA will follow."

Marco Rivera: +1 on the tone. Suggest we offer either a $200 account credit OR 2 weeks of free Dedicated seats for affected trials — depending on size. Need CS guidance on thresholds.
Priya Patel: For renewals/ARR-risk: if the account is >$50k ARR, we should escalate to AE and include 1:1 outreach. For trials under $5k, the standard credit is fine. We should tag accounts with "impact: high" if they had 3+ failed invites or are in onboarding w/ >5 seats pending.
Jade (CS Ops): I can run the impacted-account list and add tags. Query I'm using:

```
-- list accounts with invite failures in the window
SELECT account_id, org_name, seats, total_mrr
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE event = 'invite_failed'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-20 02:09:00'
  AND timestamp <= '2026-03-20 02:20:00';
```

Samir Gupta: That matches our logs. I'll share the raw delivery attempts in #eng-sre so you can cross-check timestamps.
Priya Patel: For comm owners: I propose jade sends the template to affected accounts <=5k MRR, Marco to mid-market (5k–50k), Alice + AE for >50k. Legal: please check the phrasing for liability/credits.
legal-ops: Quick review — wording is fine, avoid definitive promises around SLA credits until CS confirms numbers. Replace "we will issue a goodwill credit" with "we will offer a goodwill credit; details to follow."
Jade (CS Ops): Updated template with legal tweak. Also adding a short FAQ line: "How will credit be applied? — CS will follow up with account-specific details and apply credits to next invoice or issue account balance as preferred."
Marco Rivera: Action items so far: 1) Jade to produce affected-account CSV (ETA 20m). 2) Samir to confirm backlog clear ETA (update in 30m). 3) Priya to flag renewal-risk accounts and coordinate with AEs (ETA 40m). 4) Alice to approve final comm and send at 11:00 PT (unless legal/AE edits).
Alice Chen: I approve the approach. For credits: standard = $100 for small trial accounts, $300 for mid, bespoke for >$50k ARR (handled by AEs). If any AE wants a different offer, flag now.
Marco Rivera: CSV posted to #cs-ops: s3://redwood-incidents/onboard-invite-1887654321/impacted_accounts.csv. Passing to Jade to tag.
Jade (CS Ops): Tagging complete. Created internal spreadsheet with columns: account_id, owner_ae, seats_impacted, recommended_credit, communication_sent (y/n).
Samir Gupta: Backlog status update: 02:52 UTC — 60% cleared, expected to finish within 75 minutes. No new deploys until confirmation.
Priya Patel: AEs notified for high-risk renewals. One renewal meeting today at 14:00 GMT for Org: Greenfield Labs — AE @Marco Rivera will join.
Alice Chen: I'll draft the external message now and paste here for final sign-off.
Alice Chen: Final external message (to send):

"Hi <Account team>,

We want to let you know that between 02:09–02:14 UTC on 2026-03-20, a platform change caused delays for onboarding invites. The change was rolled back and we are completing the re-delivery of pending invites. We apologize for the disruption. To make this right, we've applied a goodwill credit to impacted accounts (details below). If you continue to see any issues, please reply and we'll escalate immediately. A full technical RCA will be shared within 72 hours.

What we did: rolled back the change, increased retry capacity, prioritized pending invite deliveries.
What you'll see: account credit applied within 3 business days; invites should finish delivering within 2 hours.

If you need immediate help, contact your AE or reply to this message.

— The Redwood Inference Team"

legal-ops: Looks good after the previous tweak.
Marco Rivera: Approved. Jade, send to small/mid CSV now; Marco and Alice will review >50k list before sending.
Jade (CS Ops): Sending smaller batch now, scheduling larger sends after AE review. I'll attach a short survey link for feedback: https://forms.redwood.ai/onboard-incident-feedback.
Alice Chen: Thanks team. Follow-up: RA/finance, please prepare to apply the credits once CS confirms list (Jade will hand off a final sheet). We'll track in the incident ticket ONBOARD-INVITE-504.
Samir Gupta: Final infra note: we'll run a postmortem doc and include remediation (config gating + deploy sentinel). RCA target: 48 hours.
Alice Chen: Closing internal thread for now — will post external send confirmation in 30m. If any urgent changes, DM me. :thumbsup:
Jade (CS Ops): External batch 1 sent at 10:20 PT. 42 accounts notified. Will update spreadsheet with replies.
Marco Rivera: Backlog fully cleared at 03:45 UTC. No further failures reported.
Alice Chen: External comm sent to all cohorts at 11:05 PT. Logged responses in the spreadsheet. Thanks everyone.
